project.name: analyze
project.description: Django-style library management app with loans, holds, fees and reports modules, using layered services/repositories/composition roots.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Defines a system clock adapter returning the local date via Django timezone utilities.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring the Django repository and system clock into the shared LoanApplication instance.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django ModelForm validating loan creation input, rejecting blank member and ISBN values.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django Loan model storing member, ISBN, lend and return dates, with a computed 14-day due date.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed loan repository implementing lookup, creation and atomic return marking.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Framework-independent loan use cases and protocols (clock, repository), plus semicolon-delimited CSV loan formatting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural typing of ports.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing for plain-text loan API endpoints and HTML loan UI pages.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for loan text API and HTML/HTMX UI: list, lend, detail and return flows with status handling.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Clock implementation returning today's local date.

nodes.name: LoanForm
nodes.summary: ModelForm for Loan with non-blank validation of member and isbn.

nodes.name: Loan
nodes.summary: ORM model of a book loan with a due_on property of lent_on plus 14 days.

nodes.name: DjangoLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Repository over Loan ORM with transactional create and select_for_update return marking.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing loan record attributes.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol for a date provider.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol for loan persistence operations.

nodes.name: ActiveLoan
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass naming the borrower of an active loan.

nodes.name: LoanApplication
nodes.summary: Application service orchestrating lending, returning and text listing of loans.

nodes.name: loan_line
nodes.summary: Serializes a loan to a semicolon-delimited CSV line.

nodes.name: loan_catalog
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML loan list page.

nodes.name: loan_catalog_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML detail page for a loan or 404s.

nodes.name: loan_collection
nodes.summary: Dispatches GET text listing and POST lending.

nodes.name: loan_lend
nodes.summary: Validates form and creates a loan, returning plain-text 201 or 400 errors.

nodes.name: loan_lend_page
nodes.summary: Handles the HTML/HTMX new-loan form and redirects or renders partials.

nodes.name: loan_detail
nodes.summary: Returns plain-text loan line or 404.

nodes.name: loan_return
nodes.summary: POST endpoint returning a loan, with 404 and 409 handling.

nodes.name: loan_return_page
nodes.summary: UI return action supporting HTMX partial, conflict page and redirect.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires FeeApplication with the Django loan repository, system clock and HTTP payment gateway into a shared fee_application instance.

nodes.name: gateway.py
nodes.summary: HTTP adapter that charges a loan fee against an external payment gateway using urllib, without following redirects, and maps network errors to PaymentGatewayFailure.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses stdlib urllib with a custom HTTPRedirectHandler that disables redirects; gateway URL is configurable via PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed repository that looks up a Loan by primary key for the fees domain.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Framework-free fee domain: protocols for loans, clock and gateway, Fee/GatewayResponse value objects, and FeeApplication computing late fees and processing payments.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for ports and frozen dataclasses for value objects (hexagonal style).

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing for fee and payment endpoints, both plain-text/HTML API routes and UI routes.

nodes.name: view_helpers.py
nodes.summary: Helpers for fee views: formats cents as dollars, runs payments translating gateway failures into status codes, and resolves a fee or a 404 response.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for viewing late fees and paying them, offering raw HTML/plain-text endpoints and template-rendered pages with HTMX partial support.

nodes.name: _NoRedirect
nodes.summary: Redirect handler that refuses all redirects so the gateway response is never silently followed elsewhere.

nodes.name: _open
nodes.summary: Opens a request with an opener that disallows redirects.

nodes.name: HttpPaymentGateway
nodes.summary: PaymentGateway implementation that POSTs a charge for a loan and returns a GatewayResponse, raising PaymentGatewayFailure when the gateway is unreachable.

nodes.name: DjangoFeeLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Finds a Loan by id via the Django ORM, returning None when missing.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the loan fields (id, due_on, returned_on) the fee logic needs.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Port protocol for looking up loans by id.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Port protocol providing today's date, enabling deterministic time in tests.

nodes.name: PaymentGateway
nodes.summary: Port protocol for charging a loan via a payment provider.

nodes.name: Fee
nodes.summary: Immutable value object holding due date, days late and fee amount in cents.

nodes.name: GatewayResponse
nodes.summary: Immutable value object with the gateway's HTTP status and body.

nodes.name: PaymentGatewayFailure
nodes.summary: Exception signalling the payment gateway was unavailable, carrying a response body.

nodes.name: FeeApplication
nodes.summary: Application service computing late fees (free for 2 days, 25 cents per day capped at 1000) and delegating payments to the gateway.

nodes.name: format_fee_amount
nodes.summary: Formats an amount in cents as a dollar string.

nodes.name: gateway_result
nodes.summary: Pays a loan fee and returns a (body, status) pair, mapping gateway failures and non-200 results to 502 and unknown loans to 404.

nodes.name: fee_or_404
nodes.summary: Returns the Fee for a loan or a 404 HttpResponse when the loan does not exist.

nodes.name: fee_detail
nodes.summary: GET view returning an inline HTML summary of a loan's late fee.

nodes.name: payment
nodes.summary: POST view that triggers a payment and returns the gateway body as plain text.

nodes.name: fee_page
nodes.summary: GET view rendering the fee detail template.

nodes.name: payment_page
nodes.summary: POST view that pays a fee and renders either an HTMX status partial or the full fee detail page with the payment result.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Provides a system-backed Clock implementation returning the current date for hold logic.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring HoldApplication with the Django repository, system clock and the loans application.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model for a hold with member, ISBN, placement, expiry and cancellation dates.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed hold repository implementing persistence, active-hold queries and cancellation.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Domain/application layer for holds: protocols, failure codes, and HoldApplication orchestrating placing, listing and cancelling holds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for ports and StrEnum for failure codes.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routes for the holds collection and hold cancellation endpoints.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for listing/placing holds and cancelling them, mapping domain failures to HTTP responses.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Clock implementation returning today's date from the system.

nodes.name: Hold
nodes.summary: Django model representing a hold placed by a member on an ISBN, with expiry logic.

nodes.name: DjangoHoldRepository
nodes.summary: HoldRepository implementation using the Hold ORM model, including transactional placement and active-hold queries.

nodes.name: HoldRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing a stored hold record.

nodes.name: LoanState
nodes.summary: Protocol exposing the borrower of an active loan.

nodes.name: LoanStateLookup
nodes.summary: Protocol for looking up the active loan of an ISBN.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol for a source of today's date.

nodes.name: HoldIdentity
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass with a hold id and sequence number.

nodes.name: HoldFailureCode
nodes.summary: Enum of hold failure reasons.

nodes.name: HoldFailure
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass carrying a failure code.

nodes.name: HoldRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol for hold persistence operations.

nodes.name: HoldApplication
nodes.summary: Application service that validates and places holds, lists active holds and cancels holds.

nodes.name: hold_line
nodes.summary: Formats a hold record as a text line.

nodes.name: _failure_response
nodes.summary: Converts a HoldFailure to a plain-text HTTP response.

nodes.name: hold_collection
nodes.summary: Handles GET (list active holds) and POST (place hold).

nodes.name: hold_cancel
nodes.summary: Handles POST cancelling a hold by id.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring the monthly report application with the Django repository and the fee application.

nodes.name: monthly_report.py
nodes.summary: Django management command that prints the previous month lending report as CSV to stdout.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed repository querying loans started within a date range.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Domain service computing per-member monthly lending stats (loans started, late returns, late fees) via injected protocols.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Management command class whose handle() renders the report as CSV.

nodes.name: DjangoMonthlyReportRepository
nodes.summary: Repository returning Loan rows lent within [start, end).

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the loan fields the report needs.

nodes.name: FeeResult
nodes.summary: Protocol for a fee result exposing amount_cents.

nodes.name: FeeCalculator
nodes.summary: Protocol for a fee lookup by loan id.

nodes.name: MonthlyReportRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol for fetching loans started in a date range.

nodes.name: MemberMonthlyReport
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding a member's monthly report totals.

nodes.name: MonthlyReportApplication
nodes.summary: Application service aggregating loans and fees per member for the previous month, sorted by late fees descending.

nodes.name: for_previous_month
nodes.summary: Computes previous-month boundaries and builds sorted MemberMonthlyReport list from loans and fees.

nodes.name: detail.html
nodes.summary: Django template showing a loan's late fee (due date, days late, amount) and conditionally rendering either the payment result or the payment form.

nodes.name: payment-form.html
nodes.summary: HTMX-enabled form partial that posts a late-fee payment for a loan and swaps the #payment-status element.

nodes.name: payment-status.html
nodes.summary: Partial rendering the payment outcome as a status or alert message depending on success.

nodes.name: detail.html
nodes.summary: Loan detail page showing lend/due/return dates and an htmx-powered return-book form.

nodes.name: list.html
nodes.summary: Loan list page rendering every loan with due and return status plus a 'Lend a book' call to action.

nodes.name: loan-created.html
nodes.summary: htmx partial confirming a newly created loan with a link to its detail page.

nodes.name: loan-form.html
nodes.summary: Reusable loan creation form partial (member, ISBN) with validation errors and htmx submit.

nodes.name: new.html
nodes.summary: Page wrapper for the lend-a-book flow that includes the loan form partial.

nodes.name: return-status.html
nodes.summary: htmx partial reporting whether a loan return succeeded or was already returned.
